svg.title: AWS: one comparison, seven business steps
svg.desc: Submit to acceptance, durable outbox, confirmed queue, leased processing and atomic outcome. A durable owner event reaches React over SSE; targeted API reads return saved results. SQL transport and delivery are expanded in the focused views.

g.text: RDS Proxy carries ordinary writes and read-only gateway replay; bootstrap connects directly.
AWS: one comparison, seven business steps
Terraform-defined · small configurable start · business handoffs, not provisioned capacity
7 starts with the acceptance receipt and overlaps 3–6. Retries recover accepted work; new logical work can receive 429/503.
